claim_scope: Only publicly attributable speeches, press conferences, press interactions/bytes, public interview appearances and Q&A interviews. Other material may test assertions but is not a source of new claims.
original_media_limitation: No full unedited recording has been compared with a complete timestamped transcript for every card. Published edited Q&A, media quotes of spoken remarks and published press conference summaries are marked accordingly. Attribution does not authenticate allegations.
removed_from_prior_release: Earlier 26-item register included website manifesto assertions, online counters, social-media-only claims, generic media narratives and editor-derived propositions. Those are removed from this public-claim review under the new source restriction.

claims.assessment: The warning is attributed to a public press conference. Its specific application depends on differentiating draft non-inclusion, final deletion, eligibility and available appeals. The warning does not establish a number of wrongly removed electors.
claims.outstanding: ECI state-wise draft and final roll figures, statutory SIR notices, objections and judicial review.
